history.overview: The Lower Terrace was once a Dragorn ceremonial platform, now a fortified Muramite staging area.

timeline.name: Terrace Construction
timeline.description: Dragorn artisans built the terrace for noble gatherings.

timeline.name: Ceremonial Era
timeline.description: Pillars and altars were erected for Dragorn rites.

timeline.name: Muramite Occupation
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the terrace and fortified it.

timeline.name: Discord Cracking
timeline.description: Discord fissures erupted, corrupting the terrace stone.
